algorithm: PPO clipped policy gradient with GAE, tanh Gaussian actions
selection: validation shallow acceptance first, then shallow error/peak score; test once after selection. If no policy passes, retain failed research candidate and mark ineligible.
training_seed_sampling: 75% near-target abs(error)<=4cm and abs(speed)<=6cm/s, 25% all train; no validation/test seeds
limitations: Model-based simulation only, not evidence of water performance
4s episodes may miss longer oscillations; repeated source development limits independence
Forward state is held constant; no future recorded commands or sensors
200ms actuator lock is an unverified assumption; sensor delay is not explicitly reproduced
Dynamics frozen from older data; current controller changes are simulated, not refitted
No online learning, new robot data collection or firmware modification
comparison_note: Previous 0.3 and new 0.8 policies trained from same seed/data/objective/update count, selected separately using validation only. Baseline matched. No ESP-DL export, firmware integration or upload.
